product_one_liner.value: SurveySparrow helps companies, especially mid-market brands, collect customer feedback across surveys, chat, WhatsApp, email, and other channels, then analyze it and act on what customers say.
product_one_liner.notes: SurveySparrow describes feedback collection across multiple channels; AWS’s company profile identifies its target as mid-market brands and notes AI-assisted insight and action.

pricing_page.notes: SurveySparrow has a public pricing page presenting subscription choices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company’s own facts page explicitly identifies Siemens and TATA Digital among companies using SurveySparrow. | named_customers.0: The company facts page names Siemens as an organization using SurveySparrow. | named_customers.1: The company facts page names TATA Digital as an organization using SurveySparrow.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile places SurveySparrow in the 201–500 employee band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The listed headquarters address locates the company in San Francisco. | hq_country: The company facts page gives its headquarters address in San Francisco, USA.

founded_year.notes: The company facts page states its founding year as 2017.

eng_blog.notes: The SurveySparrow Engineering publication contains at least two substantive posts by engineering/DevOps authors: one explains QA sharding with Kubernetes, and another details a production PostgreSQL upgrade and infrastructure migration.

public_docs.notes: SurveySparrow provides a public developer portal with a Get Started path and a separate public integration help article, meeting the multi-article/public documentation criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The dated job inventory lists all ten open job titles, including revenue operations, solution engineering, business development, marketing, and sales roles, but no AI/ML/data-science title. The source dates the inventory to 9 November 2026.

model_provider.value: SurveySparrow names OpenAI (US) and Azure OpenAI (EU) for generative-AI features; AWS also reports Anthropic Claude Sonnet in Amazon Bedrock for summarization, clustering, and sentiment scoring.
model_provider.notes: The company facts page identifies OpenAI and Azure OpenAI as generative-AI subprocessors; AWS’s technical account also says Claude Sonnet on Bedrock powers summarization, clustering, and sentiment scoring. These are reported for different features/contexts.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: SurveySparrow’s public security page names SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, and HIPAA, all within the requested certification list. | compliance_certs.0: The public security page names SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: The public security page names ISO 27001. | compliance_certs.2: The public security page names GDPR. | compliance_certs.3: The public security page names HIPAA.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest funding record identifies the round stage as Seed. | funding_date: The latest-round entry dates the seed financing to April 2019. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile identifies the latest round as a $1.4 million seed round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round is identified as the April 2019 seed round, well before the 18-month period beginning 9 May 2025; the round announcement independently confirms it was seed funding.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The dated current job board includes an active Business Development Representative - US opening, a qualifying BDR role.

launched_6mo.notes: SurveySparrow announced the launch of SparrowCRM on 3 September 2026, within the six-month window ending 9 November 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The full small executive-leadership roster lists only Ganesh R. as Business Unit Head and Shihab Muhammed as Founder & CEO; no C-level or VP-level addition inside the preceding 12 months is shown. The identified CEO is described as a co-founder. No dated C-level/VP departure or appointment surfaced.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The company’s integrations section names Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and HubSpot as CRM integrations. | crm_stack_signal.0: The integrations section names Salesforce as a CRM integration. | crm_stack_signal.1: The integrations section names Microsoft Dynamics 365 as a CRM integration. | crm_stack_signal.2: The integrations section names HubSpot as a CRM integration.
